TXSProvenance.description:
Replayable provenance for ONE source's report of ONE facility, emission, or
scheduled transmission.

Every source consulted gets its own entry, including sources that returned
nothing, so a consumer can tell "not looked for" from "looked for and
returned nothing". Source identity is DATA: PROVIDER_ID and AUTHORITY carry
verbatim what that source states about itself.

PROVIDER_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the consulted source, unique
within the publisher's own source registry. Never a display name and
never a URL.

AUTHORITY.description:
The authority under which that source publishes, verbatim as the source
states it: a spectrum regulator, an international coordination register,
a licensee, a monitoring service, or an observer compilation. Never
inferred by the publisher.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material.

SOURCE_QUERY.description:
The exact query, filter, or request parameters used, so the same rows can
be recovered by repeating the fetch.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Required: there is no encoding for a
redistributed record whose terms are unstated. A source that publishes no
terms is recorded as publishing no terms; unknown terms are never public
domain and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as that source publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

NON_COMMERCIAL_ONLY.description:
The licence forbids commercial use. Rides PER SOURCE because one record
may merge an open-terms lane beside a non-commercial cross-check, and the
strictest consulted lane governs any derived product.

NATIVE_ID.description: This source's own row, record, licence or file identifier, verbatim.

POSITION_AUTHORITY.description:
The class of authority this particular source speaks with about position.
Published per source because a record may merge a regulator lane with a
community lane; the record-level POSITION_AUTHORITY states which class the
PUBLISHED coordinate came from.

COMMUNITY_ASSERTED_HISTORICAL.description: A community assertion the sources themselves report as superseded — the facility is believed to have moved, and the coordinate describes where it formerly stood.

UNDISCLOSED.description: The facility is documented to exist and no party publishes a position at all. LATITUDE and LONGITUDE are ABSENT in this case; they are never filled with a region centroid.

REPORTED_LATITUDE.description:
Position this source reported, in decimal degrees on WGS 84, before
reconciliation. Retained unrounded so the merge stays auditable. Absent
when the source was consulted and reported no position.

CONTRIBUTED.description:
This source's report materially contributed to the published record.
False marks a source that was consulted and either returned nothing or
was outvoted; its entry is published either way.

TXSConsensus.description:
How one facility's independent source reports were reduced to the single
published position, and how strongly those reports agreed.

Agreement is CORROBORATION and is never authority: five compilations that
copied one another agree perfectly and establish nothing. Read this table
beside POSITION_AUTHORITY, never instead of it.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The publisher does not state how the reports were reduced. METHOD defaults here so an unset field can never be read as a real method.

SINGLE_SOURCE.description: Exactly one source reported the facility; nothing was reconciled.

AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE.description: A declared precedence ranking over publishing authorities selected the winning report.

MOST_RECENT.description: The report with the most recent publication or observation window won.

HIGHEST_SAMPLE_COUNT.description: The report backed by the largest independent observation count won.

CENTROID.description: The published position is computed from the agreeing reports and belongs to no single source.

PROVIDERS_CONSULTED.description:
Sources queried for this facility, including those that returned nothing.
Never fewer than the number of SOURCES entries.

PROVIDERS_AGREEING.description:
Sources whose reported position fell within the publisher's agreement
threshold. A value of 1 means the published position rests on a single
report and was never independently corroborated.

PROVIDERS_DISAGREEING.description:
Sources whose reported position fell OUTSIDE that threshold and were not
reconciled. Non-zero is the machine-readable form of a contested
position and is published alongside POSITION_DISPUTED.

WINNING_PROVIDER_ID.description:
PROVIDER_ID of the report the merge selected, copied verbatim from the
matching SOURCES entry. Absent when METHOD is CENTROID: a computed
position belongs to no single source.

POSITION_SPREAD_M.description:
Greatest surface distance in metres between any two agreeing reported
positions. Zero is meaningful only when PROVIDERS_AGREEING is 1.

CONFIDENCE.description:
The publisher's own confidence in the merged position, on [0,1]. Never a
source's figure and never a probability from a model this standard does
not name.

MERGED_AT.description: RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond instant at which the merge was performed.

TXSPriorPosition.description:
A position the facility is asserted to have occupied and vacated, retained
so a relocation never silently rewrites history.

POSITION_AUTHORITY.description:
Class of authority behind THIS coordinate, which is frequently weaker
than the authority behind the current one.

One-sigma-equivalent horizontal envelope in metres, as the source states

PROVIDER_ID.description: PROVIDER_ID of the SOURCES entry asserting this position.

TXSEmission.description:
One documented emission of one facility: a carrier or channel the facility
is stated to radiate, with the power and antenna terms published for it.

A facility radiating many carriers carries many entries; a facility whose
frequency changes by season or hour carries the documented set here and the
time-bounded usage in `$STX`. Unknown terms are ABSENT.

EMISSION_ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier for this emission within its facility record.

FREQUENCY_KHZ.description:
Assigned or nominal centre frequency in kilohertz. Kilohertz is the base
unit for this family because it spans the low-frequency broadcasting
allocations to the microwave allocations without unit switching; a
consumer joining to `$RFB` or `$TBS`, which carry megahertz, or to
`$IQC`, which carries hertz, converts at the join, explicitly. Zero means
unpublished.

BANDWIDTH_KHZ.description:
Necessary or occupied bandwidth in kilohertz as the source states it.
Zero means unpublished.

EMISSION_DESIGNATOR.description:
ITU emission designator verbatim, e.g. the necessary-bandwidth and
class-of-emission string a licence record carries. Authoritative over
MODULATION whenever both are present.

SERVICE.description: Service class of THIS emission when it differs from the facility's.

EFFECTIVE_RADIATED_POWER_KW.description:

EIRP_KW.description:
Equivalent isotropically radiated power, kilowatts. Zero means
unpublished. Published alongside, never instead of, the dipole-referenced
figure: the two differ by the dipole gain and this standard never
converts between them.

ANTENNA_HEIGHT_AGL_M.description:
Antenna centre of radiation above ground level, metres. Zero means
unpublished.

ANTENNA_AZIMUTH_DEG.description:
Main-lobe bearing, degrees clockwise from true north. Absent for a
non-directional emission; a non-directional emission is stated by
OMNIDIRECTIONAL, never by a bearing of zero.

OMNIDIRECTIONAL.description: The emission is radiated without a preferred bearing.

BEAMWIDTH_DEG.description: Half-power beamwidth in degrees. Zero means unpublished.

ANTENNA_GAIN_DBI.description:
Antenna gain in decibels referenced to an isotropic radiator. Zero means
unpublished; a real 0 dBi figure is published as a source term in
provenance rather than being indistinguishable from absence.

STATION_IDENTITY.description:
Station identification radiated on this emission, verbatim: a callsign, a
spoken or keyed identifier, or the identity string the source publishes.
Never synthesized.

SITE_NAME.description:
Facility or structure name verbatim when a source publishes one. Never

community records. Per-emission identity lives in

must not treat it as a stable key.

LATITUDE.description:
Published facility position, decimal degrees on WGS 84, produced by the
merge described in CONSENSUS. ABSENT when no source publishes a position:
a region centroid is never substituted. Per-source positions before
reconciliation live in SOURCES[].REPORTED_LATITUDE/REPORTED_LONGITUDE and
are never overwritten by this value.

Horizontal envelope in metres within which the facility is asserted to
lie, as the publisher states it. Zero means unpublished — never that the
position is exact.

POSITION_DISPUTED.description:
Credible consulted sources place the facility in materially different
locations, or a source states the position is contested. The published
coordinate remains the publisher's best merge; this flag forbids a
consumer from presenting it as settled.

PRIOR_POSITIONS.description: Positions the facility is asserted to have vacated, most recent first.

GROUND_ELEVATION_AMSL_M.description:
Ground elevation at the facility, metres above mean sea level as the
source states it. Zero means unpublished.

STRUCTURE_HEIGHT_AGL_M.description:
Overall height of the antenna-supporting structure above ground level,
metres. Distinct from any emission's antenna height. Zero means
unpublished.

STRUCTURE_COUNT.description:
Number of antenna-supporting structures at the facility. Zero means
unpublished.

EMISSIONS.description: Every emission the facility is documented to radiate.

FIRST_OBSERVED.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond bounds of the documentation or observation
window backing the published record.

SOURCES.description:
Every source consulted for this facility, including sources that returned
nothing. Required: a facility with no named sources is not publishable.

CONSENSUS.description:

Required: a published position always states the rule that produced it,
including SINGLE_SOURCE.
